g.title: Loaded by eval/adapter.py:load_eval_adapter(--reasoner-id). ATO: ato_reasoner.eval.adapter:ADAPTER — reasoner_id, event_type (LoginEvent), datasets_dir, build_driver(settings).

Built by the adapter. Uses app/bootstrap.py:build_framework_services (the same wiring as the API lifespan) plus the ATO plugin's build_services, and runs run_ato_decision → execute_decision in-process. Single source of truth for pipeline behavior — eval cannot drift from runtime.
Hybrid pgvector + ES + cross-encoder. Used directly by the retrieval dimension; embedded in the driver for the others.
RagasFaithfulnessAdapter — atomic-claim decomposition + grounding check.
OpenAI/Anthropic LLM used as scoring judge. Use a different model family from the gate where possible, to reduce in-family bias.
Persisted DecisionBundles. Read by consistency / citation dimensions for offline analysis.
Aggregate report: per-dimension metrics + threshold pass/fail + overall_passed. JSON sidecar drives the CI gate.
make eval / make eval-account_takeover exit code = 0 (overall_passed), 1 (any threshold violation), or 2 (config error). Run on demand (eval.yaml is workflow_dispatch only); gates baseline promotion.
12 curated queries with annotated relevant policy chunks; covers regulatory, version-ambiguous, jurisdiction-scoped, and risk-tier queries.
Reference policy-gate outputs with retrieved-snippet ground truth. Inputs to RAGAS faithfulness + judge grounding.
4 scenarios × 3 orderings (canonical / reversed / shuffled) — same risk signals, different event order.
Reviewed citations from canonical scenarios; judge rates each citation 1–5 for claim support.
Injection attempts, schema violations, novel patterns, fallback triggers — adversarial pressure tests.
Context Precision/Recall @k, MRR, version-resolution accuracy, jurisdiction-filter accuracy. Last two are zero-tolerance.
RAGAS atomic-claim grounding + LLM-as-judge grounding score. Hallucination rate must be 0 on the golden set.
Same risk signals × 3 orderings → must produce identical action 12/12 (zero-tolerance). Confidence variance is informational.
Per-citation judge rating (1–5) on claim support. Mean ≥ 0.80, superficial-citation rate ≤ 0.05.
Injection resistance / schema-violation handling / novel-pattern action / fallback correctness. Three of four are zero-tolerance.
